name: text-gradient-flow
title: Animated Gradient Text
description: Lòng chữ phủ dải ba màu (màu đầu bằng màu cuối) trôi ngang liên tục, liền mạch không thấy chỗ nối.

moworks.author: moworks

options.colors: three colours (the first repeats at the end)
options.period: s per colour cycle (4), linear and seamless

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after Magic UI (MIT); a faithful port is in the Magic UI collection

moworks.notes: Text filled with a 90° linear gradient of 3 colours with first = last (A, B, C, A), background-size 300 % × 100 %, clipped to the letters. The gradient shifts left one full colour cycle (3 text widths) every 4 s, linear, seamless: CSS background-position-x 0 → 300 % over 8 s (two cycles), demo one cycle per 4 s loop; letters still. Params: colors: ba màu (đầu = cuối) · speed: một vòng màu mỗi (4 s) · angle (90°).
moworks.titleVi: Dải màu chảy trong lòng chữ
